body_markdown:
[Sunsama](https://roadmap.sunsama.com/)

Feedback


[Changelog](https://roadmap.sunsama.com/changelog)


[← Back to changelog](https://roadmap.sunsama.com/changelog)[Powered by Canny](https://canny.io/powered-by-canny?utm_source=changelog_subdomain&utm_medium=powered&utm_campaign=sunsama&company=Sunsama)


Added


- Autoplan does more of what you ask. In the shortlist chat you can type a task ("also add 'call the bank'") or paste a link, and it goes straight onto your plan. You can also set or change your rules and theme days there, and Autoplan will offer to remember how you like to work.
- Autoplan works with more of your tools. It now reads any app you've connected to Sunny. If your braindump mentions a tool you haven't connected, it suggests connecting it.
- More control for AI assistants. Claude, ChatGPT and other connected assistants can now edit, complete and delete your weekly objectives, not just create them. Comments they leave show which app posted them, like "via Codex".
- Sunny knows what you're looking at. With a task open, you can say "move this" or "change this" and Sunny acts on that task.


Improved


- A cleaner look for your lists. On wider windows, Today and Daily Planning show tasks as list rows. The backlog, This week and weekly planning now use the same rows, and each task on This week shows the day it's planned for.
- Faster desktop sign-in. The desktop app signs you in through your browser. If you're already signed in to Sunsama there, it takes one click and no password.
- A smoother Autoplan. It checks off each app as it finishes reading, remembers feedback on items you've rejected, and its counts match your active filters.


Fixed


- Calendars set to "Non-blocking for tasks" no longer switch back to blocking a few minutes later
- Scheduled tasks on Today show their time as a colored badge again, so they stand out from tasks that are only projected
- Parallel timers: taking a break pauses all of them, every running timer shows on the calendar, and days that had parallel timers load without errors
- Editing or deleting a task comment no longer fails with "Error updating task"
- Stopping Autoplan takes effect right away and keeps your braindump, and it no longer sometimes skips Jira, Gmail, Todoist, Microsoft or Trello
- Autoplan stops suggesting emails you've already archived or deleted
- Sunny's evening planning email now suggests a plan built from the tasks you didn't finish
